description: This file contains utility functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, handling date/time formats, and sensitive data redaction within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: DashboardEncoder
classes.description: Custom JSON encoder for serializing complex objects like UUIDs and datetime objects in the Superset project.

methods.name: format_timedelta
methods.description: Formats timedelta objects into human-readable strings, handling negative durations.

methods.name: base_json_conv
methods.description: Converts various Python objects into JSON-serializable formats.

methods.name: json_iso_dttm_ser
methods.description: Serializes date/time objects to ISO 8601 format for JSON.

methods.name: pessimistic_json_iso_dttm_ser
methods.description: Serializes date/time objects to ISO 8601 with error handling, returning a placeholder if serialization fails.

methods.name: json_int_dttm_ser
methods.description: Serializes date/time objects to epoch milliseconds for JSON.

methods.name: validate_json
methods.description: Validates that a given string or bytes object is valid JSON.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serializes a Python object to a JSON string with customizable options.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or bytes into a Python object.

methods.name: redact_sensitive
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields in a payload using JSONPath expressions.

methods.name: reveal_sensitive
methods.description: Replaces masked sensitive fields in a payload with original values from an old payload.
